description: This article was unpublished. Contains newspaper clippings on a strike at the Dorothy Frock Co. in San Antonio, several versions of an essay by Maria Chabot, "The Texas-Mexican: an Empire on Parade." Darmouth Murals By Orozco, research. Newspapers, periodicals, 2 postcards. Dartmouth Murals, photographs.
title: Dartmouth fresco, "Laboratory of Plastics"
